verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a compliance and registered-agent services platform, which could plausibly offer scheduled or autonomous workflows, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the site was walled off by a Cloudflare challenge, and no content about automations was retrieved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
